ffmpeg.wasm, vendored for the in-browser video and audio tools (Compress Video, Video to MP3, Trim).
Source: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm

util/    @ffmpeg/util   0.12.2  (dist/esm)   License: MIT
core/    @ffmpeg/core   0.12.10 (dist/esm, single-thread build)
